quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release: Cerebras 'stood up pioneering disaggregated inference solutions with AMD to deliver Cerebras speed while increasing throughput by up to 5x, which will be in production in Q4 2026', and deepened its AWS partnership, expecting to bring its disaggregated inference and the same 5x throughput benefits to Amazon Bedrock in the first quarter of 2027. The release also states Cerebras 'Enabled support for OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol at 750 tokens per second.'
quarterly_data.figure: throughput up to 5x; AMD solution in production Q4 2026; Amazon Bedrock Q1 2027; GPT-5.6 Sol at 750 tokens per second
